audit.whatIsWrong: Rated EVEN at 5.5/10 with a TL;DR calling it 'burn-tank paradise — he has no way to stop the jog', against a 42.11% win rate over 19 games and a content layer that says the lane 'stays HARD'.
audit.why: Nautilus has point-and-click hard CC at three points in his kit: Staggering Blow roots on his first auto, Dredge Line is a 1150-range pull on 14/13/12/11/10s, and Depth Charge is an unmissable knockup. Lillia's only defensive stat is Blooming Blows' stacking Move Speed, which does nothing while she is rooted or airborne.
audit.corrected: Difficulty raised to 7/10, carry threat 7/10, diff HARD, and the TL;DR rewritten to the real instruction: farm at Q's tip and sleep him before he hooks.

audit.whatIsWrong: Six of the seven level-chart rows were wrong. Levels 1-3 were marked Skill when the content whys say they belong to Nautilus outright; Levels 4-5 and First item were marked Lillia when the whys call them conditional/even; 2+ items was Skill when the whys say his CC chain decides it.
audit.why: His spikes are Level 1 (passive root), Level 6 (Depth Charge, 120s rank 1) and every item that adds tankiness. Hers are exactly two: Level 6 Lilting Lullaby used pre-emptively, and the first burn item.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Nautilus / Nautilus / Nautilus / Skill / Lillia / Skill / Nautilus with ratings 3,3,3,5,6,5,3, proposed as matched full+content pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[1] labels Titan's Wrath as '(E)'. Titan's Wrath is his W (shield, 12s flat); Riptide is the E (three slowing waves, 7/6.5/6/5.5/5s).
audit.why: A player reading the page would watch the wrong slot for his shield timing, and the AoE that actually zones them in lane is Riptide, not Titan's Wrath.
audit.corrected: Slot letter corrected to (W). The level-chart whys now also state the decisive chain: hook pulls, Staggering Blow roots, and her move-speed kite is inert for the whole duration.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Don'ts carried no cooldown or range for the ability the entire lane revolves around.
audit.why: Dredge Line at 1150 range on a 14s rank-1 cooldown is the single number that tells a player when it is safe to step up.
audit.corrected: Don't line now names the 14s cooldown and 1150 range.
